schwab_intraday_count_cycles.difference: unmatched-stack (OPENING ++, CLOSING pairs and --) vs decisions.py 2-state O→C overwrite. activity.json does not call this.

stated_vs_code.stated_cycles_legs: walk legs time order, read only position_effect, count OPENING followed later by CLOSING, never put_call
stated_vs_code.code_cycles_legs: MATCH with mapping detail: anything not exactly position_effect=="CLOSING" is treated as OPENING (BOTH/None → O). Sort is (time, activity_id). 2-state overwrite, not unmatched stack.
stated_vs_code.stated_cycles_decisions: walk decisions, treat effect BOTH as CLOSING
stated_vs_code.code_cycles_decisions: DIVERGE: BOTH is skipped (continue); prev unchanged. Source comment: "Skip BOTH-effect (rolls). Treating BOTH as CLOSING would count the Aug 25 roll as a cycle."
stated_vs_code.public_activity_json_uses: decisions.py (activity.py: counters_from_decisions → cycles_from_legs / cycles_from_decisions). NOT schwab_intraday.count_cycles.

same_strike_or_any_strike.detail: cycles_from_legs reads ONLY position_effect; strike is never consulted. An OPENING 350P followed by a CLOSING 360C still increments.

same_expiry.detail: expiry is not read. Open 0DTE then close 1DTE still increments.

per_leg_or_per_contract.detail: quantity is unused. A 40-lot CLOSING after OPENING-mapped state counts +1, same as a 1-lot.

multi_leg_fills_one_roll.detail: group_decisions 60s-clusters a roll as one decision with effect BOTH → 0 (skipped) on cycles_decisions. The same cluster legs are walked individually; alternating O/C fragments each add to cycles_legs. One roll can add many to cycles_legs and 0 (BOTH skipped, not treated as CLOSING) to cycles_decisions. A non-BOTH multi-leg open then later multi-leg close adds 1 to cycles_decisions and typically 1 on the first C after O plus extras if O/C interleave, to cycles_legs.

effect_BOTH_at_leg_level.detail: cycles_from_legs: effect = "C" if position_effect == "CLOSING" else "O". BOTH/missing/OPENING all map to O. Observed 2026-08-27 leg position_effect values: {'OPENING': 76, 'CLOSING': 61}; BOTH at leg level count=0. At DECISION level, BOTH is skipped (not opening, not closing).

conclusion.label: leg walk counts fragmentation the decision walk does not
evidence: Published/reconstructed 2026-08-27: cycles_legs=32 vs cycles_decisions=3 on the same 137 legs / 25 decisions (13 BOTH/ROLL, 8 OPENING, 4 CLOSING).
cycles_from_decisions SKIPS all 13 BOTH-effect decisions (rolls); stated definition said treat BOTH as CLOSING — code diverges (skip, not close).

cycles_from_legs is a 2-state machine on position_effect only: anything not CLOSING maps to O, then O→C increments. No strike, expiry, put_call, or quantity. One 20-lot fill counts the same as size-1.
Of 32 cycles_legs increments: same_decision_as_prior_O=27, cross_decision=5, inside_BOTH_cluster=29, inside_ROLL=29.
A single ROLL/BOTH decision can contribute many O→C toggles to cycles_legs (max increments attributed while walking one decision=13) while contributing 0 to cycles_decisions (BOTH skipped).

60d: cycles_legs median 10 range {'min': 0, 'max': 66}; cycles_decisions median 2 range {'min': 0, 'max': 6}. Persistent legs>>decisions gap is the grain of the walk, not a one-day 32-roundtrip churn.
schwab_intraday.count_cycles is a different unmatched-stack function and is NOT what public activity.json uses.
